title: Vectors: invalid signature cases
description: Test vectors for invalid signatures. DONE - 10 vectors
close_reason: Satisfied by test/vectors/schnorr48.json: 10 invalid-signature vectors (valid=false) covering wrong-message binding, tampered challenge byte, tampered response byte, wrong public key, truncated 47-byte signature, all-zero signature, identity-point pubkey, low-order 8-torsion point pubkey, non-canonical s (=curve order L), and zero scalar s. Each is machine-consumed by python/tests/test_vectors.py::test_schnorr_vector which asserts schnorr_verify() rejects every valid=false vector ('invalid sig accepted' would fail). Ran: cd python && uv run --extra dev pytest tests/test_vectors.py -k schnorr -q => 16 passed (includes all 10 invalid cases); cross-checked via uv run --extra dev pytest tests/crypto/test_schnorr48.py -q => 10 passed.
